description: US Congress bill status from the official GPO GovInfo BILLSTATUS bulk XML (the GovTrack API it replaces has closed): title, sponsor, introduced date, latest action and official congress.gov link for one bill by congress, bill type and number. Covers congresses with BILLSTATUS files (119 at test time). Choose this tool for: US Congress bill status from the official GPO GovInfo. Close alternatives on this server: gov_global_court_records_aggregator (Court records from two official open sources in one answer); gov_global_tender_funding_watch (Latest public tender and contract items from three official). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
